channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Global oil, gold, and silver prices likely to surge as US and Israel launch massive attack on Iran
item.description: Global markets are reacting sharply after the US and Israel launched a large-scale attack on Iran, raising fears of escalating conflict. The move is expected to push up oil prices worldwide, while gold and silver are likely to see a surge as investors seek safe-haven assets. Indian markets may open weak amid geopolitical uncertainty, with traders closely monitoring developments in the region.

item.title: History in Hubballi: J&K Lift Maiden Ranji Trophy, PM, HM Lead Nation's Applause
item.description: The J&K cricket team created history by winning its maiden Ranji Trophy title, defeating Karnataka on the basis of a massive first-innings lead in the 2025–26 final at Hubballi. The landmark triumph — ending a 67-year wait — drew praise from Union Home Minister Amit Shah, Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha, and Chief Minister Omar Abdullah, who witnessed the final and later announced a ₹2 crore cash reward and government jobs for the victorious squad.

item.title: Nationwide HPV vaccination drive launched by PM Modi in Ajmer to fight cervical cancer
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launches the nationwide Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Vaccination Programme for girls aged 14 years The programme will target approximately 1.15 crore girls aged 14 years every year across all States and Union Territories. The vaccine will be provided free of cost at designated Government health facilities.

item.title: India-EU free trade deal includes five-year most-favoured-nation provision
item.description: India and the European Union have agreed to grant each other Most-Favoured-Nation (MFN) treatment for five years under their proposed free trade agreement (FTA). This ensures fair and equal treatment in trade in services, preventing either side from giving better treatment to third countries

item.title: Rashmika Mandanna makes heart sign in palki; Vijay Deverakonda arrives on horse; inside Virosh's 'Periodic Era' decor wows
item.description: Unseen photos from Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda's February 26 wedding show the bride arriving in a regal palki at Mementos by ITC Hotels, Ekaaya Udaipur, with a "Periodic Era" décor featuring earthy tones and terracotta, highlighting a simple, heritage-inspired celebration.

item.title: Iran Defence Minister Amir Hatami killed in Israeli-US strike: Report
item.description: Iran's Defence Minister Amir Nasirzadeh and Revolutionary Guards commander Mohammed Pakpour are believed to have been killed in Israeli attacks on Saturday, three sources familiar with military operations and regional intelligence told Reuters. Tehran has yet to comment publicly on the status of the two senior officials.

item.title: 'We are living in fear': Indian students in Iran plead with Govt as India expresses concern over Iran‑Israel tension
item.description: Indian students stranded in Iran have shared emotional videos urging the Government of India for urgent evacuation amid rising Iran–Israel tensions. Students say airstrikes, fear and exam schedules have left them anxious and uncertain.

item.title: UAE confirms intercepting and destroying new wave of Iranian missiles
item.description: The operation to successfully intercept the new wave of Iranian missiles was carried out with high efficiency and without any damage, the UAE's Defence Ministry stated.

item.title: Rs 593 crore fake invoice racket in Karnataka: GST practitioner in custody
item.description: The fraudulent network enabled wrongful Input Tax Credit (ITC) claims totaling nearly Rs 235 crore. Saifullah was presented in courts in Bengaluru and Belagavi and remanded to judicial custody. Officials are continuing the investigation to identify other beneficiaries and the full extent of the fraud.

item.title: "Khamenei is dead": Trump claims to have seen photographic evidence; Iran announces 40-day mourning [updated]
item.description: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei is reportedly killed in US and Israel missile attacks on the country.
